snippet.title: Gedonia PC Release Gameplay No Commentary
snippet.description:
Gedonia is an open world action rpg where you create your own story. You have pet companions, collect mounts buy houses and customize them, cook, fight, fish etc.
Gedonia is a charming game with beautiful graphics(that are not for everyone). Looks like a huge world that you can explore, only for 10$. The gameplay in this video is from the release version.

Video TimeTable:
00:00 Character Creation
01:44 Starting Cutscene
03:14 Gedonia Gameplay
